stories.title: Giant Finn Beneath Lund Cathedral in Centrala staden, Sweden
stories.summary: [ NOTE TO THE EDITOR: If this entry is published, please correct the geo header by replacing 'Centrala Staden' ('City Center') with 'Lund' so that the place is properly included in the destination guide. ] - - - In the crypt of Lund Cathedral, two stone columns stand apart from the rest. A standing male figure grips one, arms wrapped around the stone as though trying to keep it in place. Against the other leans a crouching female figure, with a child leaning against the arm she has wrapped around the stone. In the low light of the subterranean space, the sculptures feel less like decoration than interrupted movement, set among the forest of pillars that support the vault above. According to legend, the figures are the giant Finn and his family. Finn struck a bargain with Saint Lawrence to build the cathedral: if Finn’s name remained unknown before the work was complete, he would receive the saint’s eyes. Before that day came, Saint Lawrence learned the giant’s name and called it out...
